title: Bibimbap
subtitle: Korean mixed rice bowl with beef, vegetables, and gochujang
excerpt: Bibimbap is built component by component and assembled in the bowl. Each element -- the beef, the vegetables, the egg -- is cooked separately and arranged over the rice, then mixed at the table with gochujang sauce. The individual prep is what makes it practical: most components can be cooked ahead.
sourceNotes: Bibimbap means mixed rice in Korean and is one of the country's most recognised dishes. Its origins are disputed -- some accounts link it to royal court cuisine, others to the practice of mixing leftover side dishes into rice at the end of a meal. The defining element is the gochujang sauce, stirred in at the table.

content.text: Cook the rice first so it is hot when the bowl is assembled. Each vegetable topping takes only 2-3 minutes in the same pan if you wipe it between each batch.
Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and keep warm. Mix the gochujang, honey, and 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a small bowl to make the sauce. Set aside.
Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, drain, and squeeze firmly to remove excess water. Toss with a little sesame oil and a pinch of salt.

Heat a little sunflower oil in the frying pan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the julienned carrot for 2 minutes and set aside. Repeat with the mushrooms, cooking for 3 minutes. Set each aside separately.
In the same pan over medium-high heat, brown the beef mince with the garlic, breaking it up with a spoon, for 4-5 minutes. Add 1 tbsp of soy sauce and 1 tbsp of sesame oil and cook for 1 minute.
Fry the eggs in a clean oiled pan until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny.

Divide the hot rice between four deep bowls. Arrange the beef, spinach, carrot, and mushrooms in sections over the rice. Place a fried egg on top and spoon the gochujang sauce alongside. Serve with sliced spring onion.

items.cause: Gochujang sauce not mixed through before eating.
items.fix: Mix everything together in the bowl before the first bite -- the sauce is what ties all the components together.
